$description: Design tokens for mili.dev — direction 'Process'. See DESIGN.md for reasons. Themes: light = plotter ink on paper, dark = phosphor on black.

serif.role: human words: h1, essay titles, body, bio

mono.role: machine output: nav, dates, seeds, counts, eyebrows, code, captions

rules: chrome is achromatic; sig appears only in drawings, ::selection, :focus-visible
the substrate ramps glyph-thin -> glyph-rich by nutrient density: one hue per theme varying in tone, not a second accent colour
dark's glyph-thin and glyph-rich are equal ON PURPOSE — phosphor has no headroom (brighter is neon, dimmer spends presence, desaturated reads sage); see DESIGN.md
links carry a visible underline in muted (>= 3:1), darkening to ink-strong on hover; never coloured
muted must hold >= 4.5:1 on paper in both themes
code renders monochrome: ink on code-bg, no syntax colours
default is light; an explicit OS dark preference is respected; the toggle choice wins over both

motion.budget: settle-to-rest: arrival grows the first viewport once, scroll is the only other energy source, idle CPU zero; essay pages are still; sole standing exception: the living logo

substrate.style: root curtain descending the whole page; text is stone (measured DOM rects); taproot hierarchy; commit counts as an axis-free nutrient field
substrate.scrollFed: reveal target = scrollY + 1.7 viewports; chase rate 3.5x arrival; never regresses

tone.ramp: glyph-thin -> glyph-rich in 8 buckets, lerped in sRGB
tone.driver: the commit nutrient field, sampled per segment
tone.bar: visible in the mass, invisible per stroke

substrate.accent: sig dot at the deepest tip only
substrate.canvasSlices: 2048px css per slice, 42M device-px area budget

phone.stones: individual lines of text (text-node rects), ~200 vs 11 section rects; the channels contain no words
phone.origins: placed into measured free lanes (freeLanes), floor of 6 primaries — the blank page was placement failing, not mortality
phone.mortality: thin-soil relief: face 0.0015, wall 0.0018, stall 160, header 0.10 (desktop keeps 0.022/0.0015/50/0.3)
phone.reason: the gutters-are-the-lanes doctrine left 5.6% of a 390px width navigable; 3 seeds in 8 drew nothing and one drew zero segments
phone.desktop: byte-identical above the breakpoint — verified per seed

motion.determinism: geometry is precomputed per seed; time and scroll pace the reveal, never the image; seed shown in the provenance line
motion.reducedMotion: the fully grown organism, rendered synchronously; honors mid-session changes
motion.noJs: pure typography — the substrate depends on measured layout and gets no static stand-in
motion.themeOrResize: re-render the settled frame synchronously; never replay the animation
motion.lifecycle: pause on hidden, resume on visible; teardown on astro:before-swap

surface.imagery: generative only — no AI-generated images, no stock; photos only when the essay is about the photo

substrate.frame: none — no border, no box; the page is the canvas
substrate.provenance: mono caption, right-aligned, at the bottom of the soil; seed only, no data claim

fingerprint.frame: 1px hairline border, 575x136 viewBox, end of every essay
fingerprint.caption: mono, right-aligned, one quiet number (word count) — the gentlest decoder ring
fingerprint.motion: none — static build-time SVG; essay pages stay still
